attachments.text:
Hi

Back in the days Go developers on Stackoverflow use to be very helpful. Am I the only one noticing, the last couple of years, Stackoverflow users with high reputation(sometimes even devs. not high rep. in Go) closing very legit questions within minutes and being more and more bullying?

Can someone have an interest against sharing Go knowledge, or is it just human behaviour - I kind of don't think it is human behaviour, because I don't see the same "fast closing/bullying" questions in other languages on Stackoverflow?

Is there anything we can do, or is it just the way Stackoverflow is constructed.  
I will do fine without Stackoverflow Go community, but would it help new curious developers, if there was a tag for for "not so high profile questions", or anything we can do?

Where do you go and asking the "dumb questions" these days - Slack or other?

Sorry for asking ;-)
